chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a Moroccan man around 28, short black curly hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.YOUSSEF_NOW: YOUSSEF: a Moroccan man around 37, short black curly hair, trimmed beard with a few grey hairs, wearing a mustard-yellow hooded sweatshirt and black joggers, sitting in a black wheelchair
chars.KARIM: KARIM: a tall slim Moroccan young man with a buzz cut, wearing a red bomber jacket, blue jeans and a black cap
chars.AMINE: AMINE: a stocky Moroccan young man with wavy hair and glasses, wearing a green puffer vest over a white t-shirt and grey trousers
chars.DRIVER: DRIVER: a Moroccan man in his 30s with slicked-back hair and red glassy eyes, wearing an unbuttoned black shirt and a gold chain

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF_NOW sits in his wheelchair in a modest Casablanca living room at night, holding an old printed photo of himself with friends, staring at it with a heavy thoughtful expression, warm lamp light

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF_NOW in his wheelchair beside an open window at night, looking out over Casablanca rooftops with sad eyes, hand pressed on his knee, city lights in the background

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: YOUSSEF, KARIM and AMINE walking together down a lively Casablanca street at night, laughing and joking, shop lights and palm trees, happy carefree mood

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF, KARIM and AMINE sitting at a plastic table outside a small Moroccan snack shop at night after work, laughing loudly together, glasses of mint tea on the table

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF, KARIM and AMINE standing at a street food stall in Casablanca at night eating sandwiches, relaxed and smiling, steam rising from the grill

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Late night on a quiet wide Casablanca boulevard: KARIM and AMINE start crossing the road ahead, YOUSSEF a few steps behind hurrying to follow them, street lamps, slightly tense mood

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF, KARIM and AMINE walking across a white striped pedestrian crosswalk in the middle of a dark boulevard at night, the traffic light for cars is red, YOUSSEF in the middle of the road

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a speeding black Mercedes at night: DRIVER behind the wheel with red glassy eyes and a dazed grin, a cigarette in his hand and a bottle on the passenger seat, blurred street lights through the windshield

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the crosswalk at night: YOUSSEF freezes in the middle of the white striped crosswalk, turning his head in shock toward blinding car headlights rushing at him, motion blur, dramatic suspense
